_instructions: CRITICAL: Do not leak task administration terms (e.g., 'unit', 'jrn', 'package', 'coverage', 'execution') into product code names, variables, paths, or features.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines authority precedence and classifies plans as derived support.
evidenceIndex.result: Current instruction controls scope; Product Truth and machine contracts outrank plans; package cannot create product truth.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Normative authority, not runtime evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines CODE_BASED_LEAN, full-stack trace, branch safety and evidence discipline.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner scope expands only by proven dependency and state-changing journeys require canonical readback.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Normative governance, not implementation proof.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines unified multi-surface product and domain ownership.
evidenceIndex.result: Identity owns sessions; DSH owns Partner/Store/order/dispatch/support operational truth; WLT exclusively owns financial truth.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Platform requirements still require capability-specific Product Truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines contract, database, idempotency, frontend/shared, DSH/WLT and verification rules.
evidenceIndex.result: Execution must close canonical vertical slices, avoid local truth and verify data/concurrency where applicable.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Normative engineering policy.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines actor/business/object isolation, trusted context, sessions, PII and financial security.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner/store access must be server-scoped; financial operations remain WLT-owned and sensitive data minimized/masked.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Runtime isolation still needs tests.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines latest-head reconciliation and candidate-bound evidence.
evidenceIndex.result: Writes must be based on latest abbass head and evidence cannot exceed the exact candidate.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not prove product behavior.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines package-only workflow and schema-driven strict readiness.
evidenceIndex.result: This task creates disposable implementation planning only; product/runtime/governance code is not modified here.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Derived support, not product truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Requested architecture source inspected on pinned head.
evidenceIndex.result: File is zero bytes, so no architecture claim may rely on it.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Architecture must be derived from higher authority and pinned code/contracts.

evidenceIndex.result: Secure session/device fingerprint, catalog picker, push registration and partner/app-partner IdentitySessionGate wrap DshPartnerSurface.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static composition does not prove runtime behavior.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows primary surface composition and navigation.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner surface exposes operations, wallet, orders, inventory, profile, store scope, notifications, team and delivery/support routes.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Presence does not prove contract closure.

evidenceIndex.result: Surface composes profile, store scope, orders, support, operations summary and team models rather than independent business truth.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static composition does not prove backend/database correctness.

evidenceIndex.result: Bindings include readiness, orders, support, catalog/media/overrides, courier/team, WLT bridge and commercial model.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Compile-time registry does not prove live behavior.

evidenceIndex.result: Guards reject fake readiness/store truth, unsafe catalog defaults, optimistic final order truth and fake team/support behavior.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static guard coverage is partial.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines Partner onboarding/publication and required surfaces.
evidenceIndex.result: app-partner, app-field, control-panel and app-client are required slices; DSH owns Partner/Store state and WLT payout truth.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Implementation/runtime evidence remains required.

evidenceIndex.result: Partner consumes Store coverage/modes/SLA/pause impact; control-panel platform writes policy; client/captain consume consequences.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Capability is DISCOVERY.

evidenceIndex.result: Partner cannot self-activate and reads DSH activation/readiness with explicit states/retry.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not prove backend predicates.

evidenceIndex.result: Partner workboard reads canonical DSH orders and classifies loading/empty/offline/error; mutations are delegated.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not prove mutation state machine.

evidenceIndex.result: Reject, issue, handoff and delivering actions route through governed flows and refreshable order state.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Route wiring does not prove backend legal transitions.

evidenceIndex.result: Partner/Captain/control-panel required, client readback required, field and financial mutations excluded.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Needs backend/DB/runtime verification.

evidenceIndex.result: Partner issues/lists/revokes, Captain redeems/disconnects, operator reads redacted state; DSH owns fleet truth.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Runtime/protected evidence remains required.

evidenceIndex.result: Partner support is Store/order scoped; operator owns rescue transitions; WLT is visibility-only.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Capability is DISCOVERY.

evidenceIndex.result: Partner settlement/commission readback is actor-scoped; control-panel finance performs governed mutations; WLT is financial owner.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not cover every COD-specific mutation alone.

evidenceIndex.result: Composes COD custody, actor wallet, commissions and payout destination panels.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Each financial subpath still needs vertical verification.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows Partner COD read/remit API behavior.
evidenceIndex.result: Actor-scoped DSH proxy routes use correlation and idempotency for remit.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not prove WLT ledger correctness/authorization.

evidenceIndex.result: UI receives canonicalStoreId but calls fetchPartnerPerformance(period) and labels output as Store-scoped.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static UI does not prove metric scoping.

evidenceIndex.result: Marketing includes visibility gates and Partner offers; only publication-related slices are Partner-related.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not prove backend gate ownership.

evidenceIndex.result: DSH sections: administration, analytics, catalogs, dashboard, hr, login, marketing, operations, partners, platform, support; WLT: finance.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Directory presence alone does not establish relevance.

evidenceIndex.result: Provides 107-journey grouping and same-SHA/coverage/contract/runtime gates, used only for discovery completeness.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Derived support cannot create requirements/evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Partner analytics client accepts period only.
evidenceIndex.result: fetchPartnerPerformance sends /dsh/partner/analytics/performance?period=... without canonicalStoreId.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Backend may derive one Store, but cannot receive the UI-selected Store ID through this operation.

evidenceIndex.claim: Partner performance handler resolves Store through partnerStore.
evidenceIndex.result: handlePartnerPerformance gets storeID from partnerStore and calls GetPartnerPerformance with it.
evidenceIndex.limitations: partnerStore must still be inspected during implementation; selected UI Store is not handler input.

evidenceIndex.result: abbas advanced by three commits; only tools/scripts/check-archpulse-config.ps1 changed, outside Partner/package semantics.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Branch must still be re-resolved before ref update.

entries.name: bthwani2-boop/bthwani-suite-next
entries.summary: Repository is the bounded source for every included Partner dependency; execution remains scoped by unit paths.

entries.name: control-panel
entries.summary: Only Partner-linked operator slices are included: access/roles, partners, catalog/visibility, operations/handoff/support, analytics and WLT finance.

entries.name: app-client
entries.summary: Included only for Partner onboarding publication, order/custody readback and shared support compatibility where Partner truth affects client-visible state.

entries.name: app-partner
entries.summary: Primary surface: identity/readiness, Store scope, orders, catalog, team/fleet, handoff, support, finance and analytics/commercial readback.

entries.name: app-captain
entries.summary: Included only for Partner fleet connection, Store-Captain custody and shared support compatibility; independent Captain finance/workforce is excluded.

entries.name: app-field
entries.summary: Included only for field-captured Partner onboarding/evidence required before activation/publication.

entries.name: administration
entries.summary: Only Partner role/permission approval compatibility that can gate app-partner access/team authorization is included; generic administration is excluded inside the units.

entries.name: analytics
entries.summary: Included only as compatible consumer of the same Partner/Store operational analytics facts; unrelated global analytics are excluded.

entries.name: catalogs
entries.summary: Central catalog and publication controls directly affect Partner assortment/media/stock and client-visible Store/Product truth.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.summary: Generic dashboard is not a canonical Partner writer nor a required Partner journey surface in applicable Product Truth.
entries.exclusionReason: Generic dashboard is not a canonical Partner writer nor a required Partner journey surface in applicable Product Truth.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current Product Truth or pinned implementation proves this section owns, mutates, gates, or provides mandatory readback for a Partner journey in this package.

entries.name: hr
entries.summary: Workforce HR owns Captain/Field employment profiles; Partner business/team state is governed through Partner/Store and Identity boundaries.
entries.exclusionReason: Workforce HR owns Captain/Field employment profiles; Partner business/team state is governed through Partner/Store and Identity boundaries.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current Product Truth or pinned implementation proves this section owns, mutates, gates, or provides mandatory readback for a Partner journey in this package.

entries.name: login
entries.summary: Operator login is generic control-panel infrastructure and does not own Partner state or app-partner Identity session flow.
entries.exclusionReason: Operator login is generic control-panel infrastructure and does not own Partner state or app-partner Identity session flow.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current Product Truth or pinned implementation proves this section owns, mutates, gates, or provides mandatory readback for a Partner journey in this package.

entries.name: marketing
entries.summary: Visibility gates and Partner offers can affect Store/client publication; only those proven Partner publication slices are included.

entries.name: operations
entries.summary: Partner order operations, handoff exceptions and order rescue have direct operator consequences.

entries.name: partners
entries.summary: Partner onboarding/review, Store linking, activation and fleet operator readback are direct dependencies.

entries.name: platform
entries.summary: Zones/serviceability/capacity/delivery modes directly gate Partner Store coverage and fulfillment eligibility.

entries.name: support
entries.summary: Operator support queue is the authoritative counterpart to Partner support and incident/rescue escalation.

entries.name: finance
entries.summary: Partner settlements/commissions/payout/COD lifecycle requires WLT-owned finance operator controls and audit where current Product Truth permits mutation.

entries.name: DSH_SHARED_FRONTEND
entries.summary: Partner surface composes shared Partner/orders/catalog/dispatch/support/analytics/finance-link controllers.

entries.name: DSH_BACKEND
entries.summary: Partner operational reads/writes authorize and persist through DSH backend domains and bounded WLT proxies.

entries.name: DSH_DATABASE
entries.summary: Partner/Store/order/team/fleet/custody/support invariants require DSH PostgreSQL constraints, versions, audit and idempotency.

entries.name: WLT_RELATED
entries.summary: Partner payout prerequisites and finance/COD are WLT-owned truth requiring WLT backend/database/readback verification.

entries.name: CONTRACTS_AND_CLIENTS
entries.summary: Every included slice must keep OpenAPI/operation IDs/generated clients and consumers aligned.

entries.name: EVENTS_JOBS_INTEGRATIONS
entries.summary: Orders, catalog publication, fleet, notifications, support and finance may emit/audit/reconcile effects; only proven event/job dependencies are in scope.

entries.name: IDENTITY_AUTHORIZATION_SECURITY
entries.summary: Partner role/session/trusted context/Store/object scope/cross-actor isolation and financial access are mandatory.

entries.name: TESTS_AND_QUALITY
entries.summary: Each unit requires targeted static/domain/contract/database/runtime/RTL/accessibility checks by affected risk.

entries.name: RUNTIME_AND_OBSERVABILITY
entries.summary: Mobile session/device/push/native catalog picker plus API/database correlation/readback require runtime evidence.

entries.name: CI_TOOLING_AUTOMATION
entries.summary: Existing Partner/full-stack guards and targeted CI must run after final edits; no unrelated toolchain is implied.

entries.name: GOVERNANCE_AND_OWNERSHIP
entries.summary: Applicable authority, PRD, policies and Product Truth constrain every Partner unit; derived journey plans remain discovery-only.
